entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

2. This bail application has been moved on behalf of the applicant-accused in case crime No. 429 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Chharra, District Aligarh, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and she has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is mother-in-law of deceased.
The marriage of deceased with son of applicant has taken place on 8.5.2021, i. e. about two and a half years prior to the incident.
It was submitted that only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons, including applicant.

No specific role has Pushpadevi vs State Of U.P. on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168753238/
1 been assigned to the applicant.

The deceased was under depression, as her husband was working at Indore in connection with his job and deceased was pressurizing him for living with her in village and she committed suicide, due to this reason.
In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on body of deceased.
The cause of death has been shown asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.

It has been further submitted that the applicant is a lady and she is languishing in jail since 24.11.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased has suffered death other than under normal circumstances, within a period of seven years of her marriage.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Pushpadevi involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which she is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which she is suspected.

v.. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
7.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 10.5.2024 HR  Pushpadevi vs State Of U.P. on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168753238/
